verdict.rationale: The docs show WorkOS has first-class organizations and memberships: the Auth0 migration produces users, organizations, memberships and roles, roles can be scoped per organization, and custom metadata can be stored on organizations. However, nothing in the pack documents invitation flows, and organizations and memberships appear only through migration, RBAC and MCP references rather than a dedicated multi-tenancy guide. Missing for 10: any evidence of invitation flows, dedicated organization/membership modeling docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
